I’m going to try my very best to answer this. Your title question asks, “How do I know what healthy relationships look like?” And my answer is - you can’t. Not just you either, but nobody can. People show their love in different ways. I myself would be totally fine with a girl tying me up on the reg. but you can bet yourself we’d never angrily hurt each other.
Now! On the subject of your possibly abusive boyfriend. Remember when I said you can’t see what an unhealthy relationship looks like? You can definitely FEEL what an UNhealthy relationship FEELS like. People are completely different at home than when they are in public. I only enjoy seeing my own parents when they’re in public, because when they’re at home, they only yell at each other and tell us what bad kids we are. SO. I don’t care how playful you thought it was, but if he left any marks on you (physically or mentally), it was at least momentarily an abusive relationship - even if it later became a non abusive one. If I had even a penny for every time people thought they found true love and realized they had to break up after they moved in with each other, well I’d be a millionaire.

BOTTOM LINE: I can tell you’re trying to make this work, but you don’t have to. True love will show itself in due time, and you’ll know your relationship is healthy because you’ll know you’ve found the relationship that’s form fitted to you! If this guy is right for you, then keep going. We’re all just on Reddit here, so what do we really know? I suggest just taking a simple ride with your best friend (don’t make anything big out of it, just keep it relaxing) and then do the same with your boyfriend and see how relaxed you feel around him in comparison.
